thread:
omar-support: Heads up — customer Ventura reported their month-end invoice total is ~35% higher than the dashboard. Dashboard shows 'Pro' plan lines; invoice includes a separate 'Enterprise burst' line. Can someone triage?

sophie-accounts: Oof. Do we have the invoice id and billing-run id?

omar-support: Invoice INV-2026-2178, billing_run=br_2026_03_31_22. Customer says dashboard totals match until the final invoice. Attached screenshots in the ticket.

jess-billing: Looking at invoice: there's a line item with plan_code=enterprise-burst, tokens=1,234,567, effective_ts=2026-03-31T23:59:30Z. That looks like a late backfill.

li-engr-billing: I pulled metering logs. There's a backfill job (job_id=bfill_9842) that reprocessed usage for a shard at 2026-04-01T00:02:10Z and wrote a reconciled row with plan=enterprise. It ran after cutoff but before commit.

mike-cs: Customer insists they never used enterprise features. They were on Pro all month. Any chance of misattributed customer_id mapping?

li-engr-billing: Possible. Quick check: mapping table shows customer_id Ventura=CUST-7782, active_plan_history had a transient plan change to enterprise between 2026-03-31T23:58:40Z and 2026-03-31T23:59:50Z — that window is suspicious.

jess-billing: Those timestamps line up with the shard backfill write. The backfill re-evaluated some requests and assigned enterprise plan because of older promo tags present on those rows.

omar-support: So the dashboard (which reads committed daily snapshot at midnight UTC) didn't include the backfill, but the invoice (which uses the final reconciled ledger) did?

li-engr-billing: Exactly. Dashboard queries use snapshot date partition 2026-03-31. Invoice uses ledger table ledger.finalized_at <= br_2026_03_31_22 commit window. Our backfill wrote retroactive plan attribute and ledger ingestion picked it up.

sophie-accounts: Can we revert the backfill or filter those specific rows? Customer will dispute charges.

li-engr-billing: Reverting is risky. Proposal: 1) run targeted query to identify affected ledger rows, 2) confirm whether promo tag legitimately applied, 3) if not, prepare a correction entry in the next billing run (credit). Query I used:

```
SELECT ledger_id, customer_id, tokens, plan_code, written_at
FROM ledger.rows
WHERE customer_id = 'CUST-7782'
  AND written_at BETWEEN '2026-03-31T23:58:00Z' AND '2026-04-01T00:05:00Z'
ORDER BY written_at;
```

jess-billing: Ran that, found 3 rows with plan_code='enterprise-burst', tokens total 1,234,567. Promo tag in metadata: promo_source='legacy-migration' — looks incorrect for this customer.

mike-cs: Customer says they migrated from an old org in Jan, could this be a lingering legacy tag? They deny enterprise features though.

omar-support: Next steps for support/finance? Customer wants a temporary credit while we investigate.

sophie-accounts: We can offer a provisional credit pending investigation — need ENG confirmation on whether correction is safe. I'll log dispute TKT-8241 and apply provisional credit of the disputed amount.

li-engr-billing: I'll create a focused rollback patch that removes the legacy promo tag for CUST-7782 and re-ingests just those rows with plan='pro' if replayable. ETA 6 hours. If replay isn't clean, we'll create a manual correction row in ledger with negative enterprise tokens and positive pro tokens.

jess-billing: Also flagging the backfill job bfill_9842 for review — it shouldn't have changed plan attribution post-cutoff without an approval flag. I'll add a test to prevent plan attribute drift during backfills.

billing-bot: [automation] Created billing ticket TKT-8241, assigned to sophie-accounts + li-engr-billing. SLA: 48h.

mike-cs: Communicated provisional credit to customer and asked for patience. They appreciate quick action.

omar-support: Thanks team. li-engr-billing, pls post final confirmation + commit id here once corrected so I can close the support case. jess-billing, please include rollback safeguards in the backfill runbook.

li-engr-billing: Will do. I'll report back with ingest commit hash and delta CSV once done.

sophie-accounts: Noted — I'll hold off on permanent invoice changes until ENG fixes are in.

jess-billing: Filing follow-up to add a reconciliation check that compares dashboard snapshot totals vs final ledger for top 5 accounts and alerts if delta > 5% during month-end.

omar-support: Great. Closing loop for now, will update customer when you confirm. :thumbsup:
